description: Authoritative boundary contracts between the event build's agents, frozen at T14 once the owner approves v4.1 (ODR-V41-01). Domain types follow docs/FSHARP-TYPE-SHAPES.md; the stubs below fix only the names the boundaries need. Each block is valid F#; the compiler emits them in compile order and CI typechecks the result with dotnet fsi. Records of functions describe operations so they can be checked without an implementation. No nullable values: absence is an option. Nothing here is application code: implementations are written at kickoff.

interfaces.title: Domain kernel: decide, evolve, replay, project (Boundaries A, B, C)
interfaces.fsharp:
namespace Causa.Domain

/// IF41-DOMAIN: the F# kernel (Boundaries A-C). Pure: no network, clock, randomness, GitHub or browser types.
type ReplayError =
    | EmptyHistory
    | NonContiguousVersion of expected: AggregateVersion * found: AggregateVersion
    | IllegalEvent of ProjectionError
    | UnknownEventKind of string

type InvestigationProjection =
    { Investigation: Investigation
      Timeline: EventEnvelope list
      Capabilities: string list }

type DomainKernel =
    { Decide: PolicySet -> ActorContext -> Investigation option -> CommandEnvelope -> Decision
      Evolve: Investigation option -> EventEnvelope -> Result<Investigation, ProjectionError>
      Replay: EventEnvelope list -> Result<Investigation, ReplayError>
      Project: Investigation -> InvestigationProjection }

operations.name: Decide
operations.signature: PolicySet -> ActorContext -> Investigation option -> CommandEnvelope -> Decision
operations.success: Allowed with the events to append
operations.failure: Blocked, RequiresReview, UnsupportedSemantics, Conflict or Duplicate, each with its reasons

operations.name: Evolve
operations.success: the next state
operations.failure: ProjectionError: the event is illegal in this state

operations.name: Replay
operations.success: the replayed investigation

operations.name: Project
operations.success: the projection the views and report read

interfaces.concurrency: Pure functions; no ordering constraint beyond history order. Replay applies events in version order and refuses a gap.
interfaces.versioning: Frozen at T14. Any change to a union or record, including an added case, is breaking (incomplete matches are errors under TreatWarningsAsErrors): it goes through the coordinator as a new contract version, with every consumer's contract tests changed and passing in the same pull request.

interfaces.title: causa-storage v1.0.0 file sets: path, encode, verify (Boundary D, storage half)

namespace Causa.Persistence

open Causa.Domain

/// IF41-STORAGE: causa-storage v1.0.0 file sets (CONTRACT.md wins over docs/CAUSA-DATA-CONTRACT-v1.md).
type CommitOid = CommitOid of string
type RepoPath = RepoPath of string

type FileSet =
    { Manifest: byte[]
      Events: byte[]
      Snapshot: byte[] }

type VerificationFailure =
    | SchemaInvalid of file: string * detail: string
    | DigestMismatch of field: string
    | ContractValueMismatch of field: string * expected: string * actual: string
    | SnapshotDiffersFromReplay of paths: string list
    | MissingRequiredField of file: string * field: string
    | ReplayRejected of ReplayError

type VerifiedInvestigation =
    { Investigation: Investigation
      History: EventEnvelope list
      ReadAt: CommitOid
      Bytes: FileSet }

type StorageCodec =
    { PathOf: InvestigationId -> RepoPath
      Encode: VerifiedInvestigation -> EventEnvelope list -> FileSet
      Verify: CommitOid -> FileSet -> Result<VerifiedInvestigation, VerificationFailure list> }

operations.name: Encode
operations.success: the canonical file set (RFC 8785)

operations.name: Verify
operations.success: the verified investigation

interfaces.concurrency: Verify is pure and total over bytes; Encode is deterministic (canonical JSON, RFC 8785).
interfaces.versioning: Pinned to causa-storage v1.0.0; a contract change needs STORAGE-003 versioning and, as for every interface, every consumer's contract tests in the same pull request.

interfaces.title: HTTP as data between persistence and the browser host
interfaces.fsharp:
namespace Causa.Persistence

/// IF41-WIRE: HTTP as data. Persistence builds requests and decodes answers; the App runtime only executes them
/// through Limen and returns the raw result (decoding stays inside persistence: ODR-V4-06, approved in APR-V4-OWNER-1).
type RequestId = RequestId of int64

type HttpMethod =
    | Get
    | Post
    | Put
    | Patch

type HttpRequest =
    { Id: RequestId
      Method: HttpMethod
      Url: string
      Headers: (string * string) list
      Body: string option }

type TransportFailure =
    | FailedBeforeSending
    | LostAfterSending
    | TimedOut

type HttpOutcome =
    | Answered of RequestId * status: int * headers: (string * string) list * body: string
    | NotAnswered of RequestId * TransportFailure

/// The host's only network operation: execute one request exactly once and return its raw outcome; it never retries.
type Execute = HttpRequest -> HttpOutcome

/// The credential is opaque everywhere: its representation is private to this module, it prints as "<credential>",
/// and its only use is the Authorization header persistence adds to each request (PF-015, INV-21).
[<RequireQualifiedAccess>]
module Credential =
    type T =
        private
        | Token of string
        override _.ToString() = "<credential>"

    let create (token: string) : T = Token token

    let authorization (Token token) : string * string = "Authorization", "Bearer " + token

type Repository = { Owner: string; Name: string; Branch: string }

/// What every request needs after Connect: the repository and the credential. The engine keeps it in its model.
type ConnectionContext = { Repository: Repository; Credential: Credential.T }

/// What an operation may use to emit a request. Every operation emits at most one request, which carries NextId; the
/// engine advances NextId after each operation that emitted one, so identities are unique across the tab.
/// MutationInFlightElsewhere says whether another investigation in this tab has a mutation in flight (T-S04, T-S53).
type RequestContext =
    { Connection: ConnectionContext
      NextId: RequestId
      MutationInFlightElsewhere: bool }

operations.name: Execute
operations.success: Answered with status, headers and body
operations.failure: NotAnswered with FailedBeforeSending, LostAfterSending or TimedOut

operations.name: Credential.authorization
operations.success: the Authorization header for a request persistence builds
operations.failure: total; the token appears nowhere else

interfaces.concurrency: Every request carries a RequestId; every outcome names it. The host executes requests in the order given and never retries.
interfaces.versioning: Frozen at T14. Any change to a union or record, including an added case, is breaking (incomplete matches are errors under TreatWarningsAsErrors): it goes through the coordinator as a new contract version, with every consumer's contract tests changed and passing in the same pull request.

interfaces.title: GitHub answer classification (github-error-matrix.json)
interfaces.fsharp:
namespace Causa.Persistence

/// IF41-ERRORS: the classification of github-error-matrix.json. Every provider answer maps to exactly one case.
type RateLimitKind =
    | Primary of resetAtEpochSeconds: int64 option
    | Secondary of retryAfterSeconds: int option

type ProviderError =
    | AuthenticationFailed
    | PermissionDenied of operation: string
    | RateLimited of RateLimitKind
    | StaleHead of expected: CommitOid * actual: CommitOid option
    | ValidationFailed of messages: string list
    | NotFound of what: string
    | HistoryRewritten of expected: CommitOid
    | NetworkUnavailable of TransportFailure
    | Malformed of detail: string
    | ReadBackMismatch of commit: CommitOid
    | Unrecognised of status: int

/// A 2xx answer that decoded: the request it answers and its body, for the caller to decode further.
type ProviderAnswer = { Request: RequestId; Status: int; Body: string }

type Classifier = HttpOutcome -> Result<ProviderAnswer, ProviderError>

/// The answer to Connect (EXT-DATA-005): write access comes only from the permissions GitHub states for the
/// repository, never from a successful read.
type ConnectResult =
    | ConnectAccepted of canWrite: bool
    | ConnectRejected of ProviderError
    | ConnectSuperseded

/// Persistence builds the Connect request and decodes its answer; the App maps ConnectResult to SM-CONNECTION's events.
type Connector =
    { ConnectRequest: RequestId -> ConnectionContext -> HttpRequest
      InterpretConnect: RequestId -> HttpOutcome -> ConnectResult }

operations.name: Classifier
operations.success: ProviderAnswer for a 2xx answer that decoded
operations.failure: one ProviderError case per github-error-matrix.json class

operations.name: ConnectRequest
operations.success: the request that reads the repository and its permissions

operations.name: InterpretConnect
operations.success: ConnectAccepted with write access from the stated permissions
operations.failure: ConnectRejected with the classified ProviderError, or ConnectSuperseded for an answer to another request

interfaces.concurrency: Classification is a pure function of one outcome; it never consults timing or other requests.

interfaces.title: Save-state machine and session (SM-SAVE, SM-CONFLICT)
interfaces.fsharp:
namespace Causa.Persistence

open Causa.Domain

/// IF41-SAVE: the SM-SAVE, SM-CONFLICT and SM-LOAD machines (requirements-compiled/v4/state-machines.json). Pure;
/// effects are data. Each state union has exactly the machine's states and each input union exactly its events
/// (check X05); state-machine-contracts.json decides every (state, input) pair.
/// Confirmation (PERSIST-023): the only proof that a save succeeded. Its representation is private to this module, so
/// no other file, in this assembly or another, can build one; its only constructor requires the bytes re-read at the
/// commit to equal the bytes written. (A caller can still pass the same bytes twice: the plan's INV-01 tests guard
/// that path.)
[<RequireQualifiedAccess>]
module Confirmation =
    type T =
        private
            { Investigation: InvestigationId
              Commit: CommitOid
              CommittedAt: System.DateTimeOffset }
        member c.InvestigationId = c.Investigation
        member c.CommitOid = c.Commit
        member c.CommitTime = c.CommittedAt

    let ofReadBack (investigation: InvestigationId) (commit: CommitOid) (committedAt: System.DateTimeOffset) (written: FileSet) (readBack: FileSet) : T option =
        if written = readBack then Some { Investigation = investigation; Commit = commit; CommittedAt = committedAt } else None

type WriteMarker = { Session: System.Guid; Sequence: int64 }

type SaveFailure =
    | Refused of ProviderError
    | RepositoryKeptChanging
    | BytesDiffer of CommitOid
    | HistoryWasRewritten
    | CredentialNotAccepted

/// An unsaved command the engine refused when it was re-decided against the GitHub version, with the engine's reason
/// (T-C07, PERSIST-012).
type RefusedCommand = { Command: CommandEnvelope; Reason: string }

/// SM-CONFLICT states.
type ConflictView =
    | ReadingRemote of RequestId
    | Reviewable of remote: VerifiedInvestigation
    | Reapplying of remote: VerifiedInvestigation
    | Reapplied of remote: VerifiedInvestigation * refused: RefusedCommand list
    | ConfirmingDiscard of remote: VerifiedInvestigation
    | Discarded of remote: VerifiedInvestigation
    | RemoteUnavailable
    | Unresolvable of reason: string

/// SM-CONFLICT events.
[<RequireQualifiedAccess>]
type ConflictInput =
    | RemoteVerified of VerifiedInvestigation
    | RemoteReadFailed of TransportFailure
    | RemoteMissingOrInvalid of VerificationFailure option
    | ReadAgain
    | ReviewChosen
    | ReapplyChosen
    | ReapplyDone of accepted: CommandEnvelope list * refused: RefusedCommand list
    | DiscardChosen
    | DiscardConfirmed
    | DiscardCancelled
    | ExportChosen
    | SupersededReply of RequestId

/// What a Saved state rests on: a save confirmed by read-back (PERSIST-023), or a verified read at a named commit after
/// a load or a confirmed discard. The owner approved that the second shows as Saved (ODR-V4-08, APR-V4-OWNER-1).
type SavedBasis =
    | Confirmed of Confirmation.T
    | VerifiedAt of VerifiedInvestigation

/// SM-SAVE states (PERSIST-031: exactly seven).
[<RequireQualifiedAccess>]
type SaveState =
    | Saved of SavedBasis
    | Unsaved
    | Saving
    | Offline
    | Conflict of ConflictView
    | UnknownOutcome of automaticReadsLeft: int
    | SaveFailed of SaveFailure

/// SM-SAVE events. Persistence produces every reply event from an HttpOutcome with SaveMachine.Interpret; the App
/// produces only Edit, SaveRequested, CheckAgain, WentOffline, WentOnline and QueuedSaveStarted.
[<RequireQualifiedAccess>]
type SaveInput =
    | Edit of CommandEnvelope
    | SaveRequested
    | MutationSent of RequestId
    | ReadBackMatched of Confirmation.T
    | ReadBackMismatched of CommitOid
    | StaleHeadUnrelated of freshHead: CommitOid
    | StaleHeadSameInvestigation of freshHead: CommitOid
    | ProviderRefused of ProviderError
    | CredentialRefused
    | AnswerLost
    | FailedBeforeSending
    | ReconcileMarkerBytesMatch of Confirmation.T
    | ReconcileMarkerBytesDiffer of CommitOid
    | ReconcileNothingWrittenHeadUnchanged
    | ReconcileNothingWrittenHeadMoved of head: CommitOid
    | ReconcileHistoryRewritten
    | ReconcileReadFailed
    | ReconcileReadsSpent
    | CheckAgain
    | WentOffline
    | WentOnline
    | ConflictResolvedReapplied of CommandEnvelope list
    | ConflictResolvedDiscarded of VerifiedInvestigation
    | SupersededReply of RequestId
    | QueuedSaveStarted
    | RebaseReadFailed
    | ReadBackReadFailed

/// Why a load failed: the files did not verify, or the provider refused or did not answer (IF41-ERRORS), so the
/// application can state the cause truthfully (PERSIST-024).
type LoadFailure =
    | Unverifiable of VerificationFailure list
    | ProviderFailed of ProviderError

/// The read a load is waiting for.
type LoadAwaiting =
    | LoadHead
    | LoadFilesAt of CommitOid

/// SM-LOAD states.
type LoadState =
    | NotLoaded
    | Loading of RequestId * LoadAwaiting
    | Loaded of VerifiedInvestigation
    | LoadFailed of LoadFailure
    | UnavailableOffline

/// SM-LOAD events.
[<RequireQualifiedAccess>]
type LoadInput =
    | OpenRequested of InvestigationId
    | LoadVerified of VerifiedInvestigation
    | LoadRejected of LoadFailure
    | WentOffline
    | WentOnline
    | RefreshRequested
    | SupersededReply of RequestId

type Politeness =
    | Polite
    | Assertive

type SaveEffect =
    | Send of HttpRequest
    | ScheduleReconcileRead of InvestigationId * afterMilliseconds: int
    | Announce of Politeness * text: string
    | ExportCommands of CommandEnvelope list

/// The fail-closed answer to an illegal (state, input) pair: state, base head and unsaved changes are unchanged.
type SaveFault = { Machine: string; State: string; Input: string; Reason: string }

/// The answer a session is waiting for, so Interpret knows what it means. These are steps inside Saving and
/// UnknownOutcome; no machine state is added.
type Awaiting =
    | MutationAnswer
    | ReadBackAt of CommitOid
    | FreshHead
    | FileComparisonAt of freshHead: CommitOid
    | ReconcileHead
    | ReconcileCommits of page: int
    | ReconcileFilesAt of CommitOid

type InvestigationSession =
    { Id: InvestigationId
      BaseHead: CommitOid
      State: SaveState
      Unsaved: CommandEnvelope list
      AfterInFlight: CommandEnvelope list
      Outstanding: (RequestId * Awaiting) option
      Mutations: int
      RebaseAttempts: int
      ReconcileReads: int }

/// What one answer means for a session.
type Interpretation =
    /// The answer completes a step: apply this event with SaveMachine.Step.
    | MachineEvent of SaveInput
    /// The answer leads to the next read of the same step (read-back after the mutation, file comparison after a
    /// fresh head, the next reconciliation page): send the request; the session, whose Outstanding now names it, keeps
    /// its state.
    | NextRequest of InvestigationSession * HttpRequest

/// What one answer means for a load.
type LoadInterpretation =
    | LoadEvent of LoadInput
    | LoadNextRequest of LoadState * HttpRequest

/// What one answer means for a conflict review.
type ConflictInterpretation =
    | ConflictEvent of ConflictInput
    | ConflictNextRequest of ConflictView * HttpRequest

/// Every operation that emits a request uses RequestContext.NextId for it (at most one per call) and records it as
/// Outstanding; an answer whose RequestId is not Outstanding is SupersededReply.
type SaveMachine =
    { Initial: VerifiedInvestigation -> InvestigationSession
      /// Classifies and verifies one answer (IF41-ERRORS, read-back, reconciliation) against what the session awaits.
      Interpret: RequestContext -> InvestigationSession -> HttpOutcome -> Interpretation
      Step: RequestContext -> InvestigationSession -> SaveInput -> Result<InvestigationSession * SaveEffect list, SaveFault>
      /// The timer of ScheduleReconcileRead fired: in UnknownOutcome with automatic reads left, send the next
      /// reconciliation read (state unchanged); with none left, Step ReconcileReadsSpent.
      ReconcileDue: RequestContext -> InvestigationSession -> Result<InvestigationSession * SaveEffect list, SaveFault>
      InterpretConflict: RequestContext -> ConflictView -> HttpOutcome -> ConflictInterpretation
      StepConflict: RequestContext -> ConflictView -> ConflictInput -> Result<ConflictView * SaveEffect list, SaveFault>
      InterpretLoad: RequestContext -> LoadState -> HttpOutcome -> LoadInterpretation
      StepLoad: RequestContext -> LoadState -> LoadInput -> Result<LoadState * SaveEffect list, SaveFault> }

operations.name: Initial
operations.success: a session in Saved (VerifiedAt), as the owner approved (ODR-V4-08)

operations.name: Interpret
operations.success: MachineEvent, or NextRequest with the session awaiting the next read of the same step
operations.failure: total: every answer, including an unrecognised one, maps to an event (AnswerLost, ProviderRefused, SupersededReply)

operations.name: Step
operations.signature: RequestContext -> InvestigationSession -> SaveInput -> Result<InvestigationSession * SaveEffect list, SaveFault>
operations.success: the next session and its effects (state-machine-contracts.json)
operations.failure: SaveFault for an illegal pair; nothing changes

operations.name: ReconcileDue
operations.signature: RequestContext -> InvestigationSession -> Result<InvestigationSession * SaveEffect list, SaveFault>
operations.success: the next automatic reconciliation read, within PERSIST-016's budget

operations.name: InterpretConflict
operations.success: ConflictEvent, or ConflictNextRequest for the next read

operations.name: StepConflict
operations.signature: RequestContext -> ConflictView -> ConflictInput -> Result<ConflictView * SaveEffect list, SaveFault>
operations.success: the next conflict view and its effects
operations.failure: SaveFault for an illegal pair; nothing changes

operations.name: InterpretLoad
operations.success: LoadEvent, or LoadNextRequest for the files after the head

operations.name: StepLoad
operations.signature: RequestContext -> LoadState -> LoadInput -> Result<LoadState * SaveEffect list, SaveFault>
operations.success: the next load state and its effects
operations.failure: SaveFault for an illegal pair; nothing changes

operations.name: Confirmation.ofReadBack
operations.signature: InvestigationId -> CommitOid -> DateTimeOffset -> FileSet -> FileSet -> Confirmation.T option
operations.success: Some when the re-read bytes equal the written bytes

interfaces.concurrency: One Step per input, applied in arrival order on the single UI thread; at most one mutation in flight per tab, and each session awaits at most one answer (Outstanding, with the step it belongs to). Interpret turns an answer whose RequestId is not Outstanding into MachineEvent SupersededReply, which is legal only where state-machine-contracts.json lists it (T-S39, T-S40, from ODR-V4-03, approved in APR-V4-OWNER-1); in every other state it fails closed with SaveFault and changes nothing.
interfaces.versioning: Frozen at T14. Any change to a union or record, including an added case, is breaking (incomplete matches are errors under TreatWarningsAsErrors): it goes through the coordinator as a new contract version, with every consumer's contract tests changed and passing in the same pull request.

interfaces.title: Limen engine: Model, Msg, effects to and from the browser host
interfaces.fsharp:
namespace Causa.App

open Causa.Domain
open Causa.Persistence

/// IF41-APP: the Limen engine boundary (App <-> browser host). The host relays only what the engine asks for.
/// The credential is opaque (IF41-WIRE Credential): created once from the Connect form, kept only in the model's
/// connection context, never rendered, logged or stored.
/// SM-CONNECTION states.
type ConnectionState =
    | Disconnected
    | Connecting of RequestId
    | Connected of canWrite: bool
    | CredentialRefused
    | Reauthenticating

/// SM-CONNECTION events.
[<RequireQualifiedAccess>]
type ConnectionInput =
    | ConnectSubmitted of Repository * Credential.T
    | ConnectSucceeded of canWrite: bool
    | ConnectRefused of ProviderError
    | AuthFailed
    | ReconnectSubmitted of Credential.T
    | DisconnectConfirmed

/// SM-NETWORK states.
[<RequireQualifiedAccess>]
type NetworkState =
    | Online
    | Offline

/// SM-NETWORK events.
[<RequireQualifiedAccess>]
type NetworkInput =
    | OfflineObserved
    | OnlineObserved

/// What a host timer is for.
type TimerKey = ReconcileTimer of InvestigationId

type BrowserSignal =
    | ConnectivityChanged of online: bool
    | TimerFired of TimerKey
    | HttpCompleted of HttpOutcome
    | LeaveAttempted

type HostEffect =
    | Http of HttpRequest
    | Timer of TimerKey * milliseconds: int
    | SetLeaveGuard of bool
    | Download of fileName: string * content: string
    | LiveAnnounce of Politeness * text: string

type Route = Route of string

type Msg =
    | Navigate of Route
    | Browser of BrowserSignal
    | Connection of ConnectionInput
    | Network of NetworkInput
    | SessionInput of InvestigationId * SaveInput
    | ConflictStep of InvestigationId * ConflictInput
    | LoadStep of InvestigationId * LoadInput
    | DomainCommand of CommandEnvelope

/// The model keeps the connection context after Connect succeeds and the next request identity of the tab.
type Model =
    { Connection: ConnectionState
      Context: ConnectionContext option
      NextRequestId: RequestId
      Network: NetworkState
      Route: Route
      Loads: Map<InvestigationId, LoadState>
      Sessions: Map<InvestigationId, InvestigationSession> }

type Engine =
    { Init: Route -> Model * HostEffect list
      Update: Msg -> Model -> Model * HostEffect list }

operations.name: Init
operations.success: the initial model and effects

operations.name: Update
operations.success: the next model and effects
operations.failure: total: an illegal machine input leaves the model unchanged and announces the SaveFault

interfaces.concurrency: Update is pure; HostEffects run in list order; BrowserSignals arrive one at a time.
